title: Tom Cruise's New Film Could Lose $245 Million

source.author: Andrew McGowan
source.title: Tom Cruise's 'Digger' could be one of Hollywood's biggest flops ever, with a projected $245 million loss
source.notes: Production budget left out: Fortune reports $160-180 million, Warner Bros. disputes it (reports cite $125-150 million). Loss and break-even figures are Variety's, as reported by Fortune.

figures.quote: opened to an underwhelming $8 million at the domestic box office over the Oct. 2 weekend
after a 60% drop in its second weekend
tracking to lose an estimated $245 million, according to Variety
projected to finish its run at around $50 million globally
a global marketing campaign estimated at roughly $100 million

figures.text: theaters keep roughly half of ticket sales
figures.quote: the roughly half of ticket sales that theaters keep
needs to gross about $350 million worldwide to break even
the break-even point is closer to $300 million
debuted at a 52% score on Rotten Tomatoes
opening-night audiences gave it a C+ CinemaScore

figures.text: ad with good and bad reviews: decide for yourself
Anne Hathaway, Jane Fonda praised it on social media
figures.quote: Hollywood figures including Anne Hathaway, Jane Fonda, Guillermo del Toro, and Mandy Patinkin

figures.text: John Carter, The Lone Ranger each lost around $200 million
figures.quote: each estimated to have lost around $200 million

figures.text: Paramount Skydance closed roughly $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on October 6
figures.quote: closed its roughly $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on Oct. 6
